engine.name: Daisy
engine.library: DAISYHOME lib/ (tillage.dai, crop.dai, log.dai and the files they load) from the same git commit
engine.license: GNU GPL v2 (repo COPYING.txt); repo also ships COPYING.LIB (GNU LGPL v2.1)

simulation.site: Andeby (fictional sandy Danish farm), Taastrup weather (daily)
simulation.soil: FAO3 sandy Ap (0-20 cm) over C horizon to 2.5 m, deep groundwater (free drainage)
simulation.management: plow 1987-03-20; 100 kg mineral N 04-04; sow grass + spring barley 04-05; barley harvest at DS 2.0 (1987-08-26); 80 kg N 09-08; grass cut 10-10
